svg.title: EvalVitals MMAU case study
svg.desc: EvalVitals applied to Gemma-4-E2B on MMAU audio understanding: probing, statistical screening, hypotheses, held-out verification, and an empirical L2 repair.
svg.text: probe freely · inspect many signals · form hypotheses
- Did it answer in the form we asked for?
- Did it stop, or keep talking?
- Same question five times, same answer?
- Was it as sure as it sounded?
- Did it ever produce the right answer?
Using plots to explain, statistical tests to
one row per candidate signal, extra
failure rate when the signal is high
Explore the reason behind the signals
The loop still produced a repair that
works, so the gain below is an empirical
Fix the failure with the validated repair ladder
Example: 849941ed — Q: Which instruments are primarily featured in the audio? A: (A) Violin and Cello
Check each option against what was heard
Over the full held-out testing cases
30 fixed, 8 broken, gain far beyond chance (e-value 144)
No hypothesis reached SUPPORTED, so this is a measured improvement,
